weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly specify the limitations of the proposed method, particularly regarding the assumptions about loss function monotonicity.
The paper lacks a thorough comparison with existing methods beyond a brief mention, which could help contextualize the claimed improvements.
The examples provided in the paper could benefit from more detailed quantitative results to substantiate the claims of effectiveness.
strengths: The proposed conformal risk control framework extends existing methods in a novel way, allowing for the regulation of various monotone loss functions.
The theoretical guarantees provided for the method are rigorous and well-articulated, enhancing the credibility of the approach.
The practical examples across different domains demonstrate the versatility and applicability of the proposed method.
